#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    std::string str;
    std::getline(std::cin, str);
    if (str.empty()) {
        std::cout << 0 << std::endl;
        return 0;
    }
    std::vector<int> starts;
    starts.push_back(0);
    for (int i = 1; i < (int)str.length(); ++i) {
        if (str[i] != str[i - 1]) {
            starts.push_back(i);
        }
    }
    int os = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)starts.size(); ++i) {
        int end = (i + 1 < (int)starts.size()) ? starts[i + 1] : (int)str.length();
        if ((end - starts[i]) % 2 == 0) {
            os += 1;
        }
    }
    std::cout << os << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
